segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמְקַבֵּל שָׂדֶה מֵחֲבֵירוֹ וְלֹא רָצָה לְנַכֵּשׁ, וְאָמַר לוֹ: מָה אִיכְפַּת לְךָ? הוֹאִיל וַאֲנִי נוֹתֵן לְךָ אֶת חֲכִירָךְ – אֵין שׁוֹמְעִין לוֹ. מִפְּנֵי שֶׁיָּכוֹל לוֹמַר לוֹ: לְמָחָר אַתָּה יוֹצֵא מִמֶּנָּה וּמַעֲלֵת לְפָנַי עֲשָׂבִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who received a field from another» to cultivate «and did not want to weed» it, «and» he then «said to» the owner: «What do you care» if I neglect the land? You will not suffer a loss «since I» will «give you» the amount of produce I owe you for «your» granting me «tenancy,» regardless of the state of the field. Nevertheless, «they do not listen to him.» The reason is «because» the owner of the land «can say to him: Tomorrow you» will «depart from» the field, «and it» will «grow weeds for me,» which will remain there and disrupt the yield of the field for years to come.
